criteria.text: The response concludes that the Distribution Agreement grants Brisosk exclusivity over all customers across the full five-state Territory and bars Rirux's own direct and national-account sales in that Territory. It also concludes that this goes far beyond the healthcare-only, Pennsylvania/New Jersey exclusivity recorded in the side letter, and that the side letter does not cure the breadth. The response locates the issue in Distribution Agreement Section 2.1, explains why this matters to Rirux, and recommends a fix.
hints: Healthcare Laundry Accounts in Pennsylvania and New Jersey

criteria.text: The response concludes that Rirux's December 10, 2025 non-renewal notice was untimely under the 90-day notice requirement, so the agreement has likely renewed automatically for a three-year term. The response locates the issue in Distribution Agreement Section 9.2, explains why this matters to Rirux, and recommends a fix.

The response concludes that the Statement of Work defines 'Critical Failure' to include any malfunction reducing rated throughput by 10% or more, far broader than the Distribution Agreement's 'wholly inoperable' definition. It also concludes that this broader SOW definition governs the four-hour response obligation and service credits. The response locates the issue in SOW Section 3.1, explains why this matters to Rirux, and recommends a fix.
The response states that the Distribution Agreement's Effective Date is March 1, 2024.
The response states that the Distribution Agreement's Initial Term is two years.
The response is a memo that lists the issues in ranked order, with the items most important to Rirux placed first.
The response identifies at least one point that needs facts the documents do not supply, and states what to ask the client about it.
The response claims that Rirux's December 10, 2025 non-renewal notice was timely under the Distribution Agreement.
The response claims that the side letter's narrower healthcare-only, Pennsylvania/New Jersey exclusivity scope prevails over the Distribution Agreement's exclusivity grant.
